title: CSF clearance through arachnoid fenestrations to olfactory meningeal lymphatics.

verified.what_i_actually_checked: Ran paper_context.py: Europe PMC flags show not open access, no full text, no supplement, no data links, no text-mined dataset accessions (only antibody RRIDs, i.e. research resource identifiers for reagents). Zenodo/Dryad DOI search returned nothing. The single NCBI PMC link (PMC13637766) turned out to be a citing review in Drug Delivery, not this paper.
verified.what_came_from_paper_text_only: Everything about the study (mouse and cynomolgus monkey tracer imaging, arachnoid fenestration counts, ageing and VEGF-C, vascular endothelial growth factor C, rescue) comes from the abstract alone.

a1_downloadable.note: No deposited dataset found: no repository accession, no Zenodo/Dryad record, no open supplement. Paper is paywalled. Checked via Europe PMC and NCBI links only.

a2_label_is_a_column.note: Not checked against files (none exist). This is a microscopy and tracer-imaging study; any label (fenestration counts, tracer intensity) would have to be built from raw images.

a5_enough_rows.note: Mouse imaging cohorts are typically tens of animals; no row count seen.

a8_label_provenance.note: Not assessable; labels would be manual image quantifications if any were released.

honest_claim_h3: No claim possible: no public data were found for this study.

plain_idea.one_liner: Use microscopy images of the mouse olfactory meninges to predict age or fluid-clearance capacity from lymphatic and fenestration structure.
plain_idea.train_on: Would be imaging of arachnoid membranes and dural lymphatics per mouse; number of examples unknown and no images are deposited.
plain_idea.predict: Age group or measured tracer clearance into cervical lymph nodes, both from the authors' experiments, which are not released.
plain_idea.why_worthwhile: Could automate quantifying brain-fluid drainage structures in ageing research, but without released data it cannot be started.

ml_idea: None feasible: a small-cohort mouse imaging study with no deposited data.

effort.compute_note: Not estimated; no data exists to size.
effort.cheapest_killing_check: Search for a data availability statement on the Cell article page; it already fails on Europe PMC/NCBI/Zenodo/Dryad.

verdict_reason: Paywalled mouse imaging study with no deposited dataset, accessions or open supplement; A1 fails, and any data would be a small animal cohort needing labels built from images.
